verdict.rationale: Docs confirm point-in-time restore from backup revision history and full/incremental backups (cockroachdb-docs-15, -6, -30), directly supporting the 'restore to any point in time' part of the story, but there is no evidence of a 'branching' capability, and community reports indicate backup/restore has historically been gated behind the enterprise license (cockroachdb-comm-1, cockroachdb-comm-8), adding a real caveat. missing for 10: evidence of database branching/cloning, explicit retention-window configuration details, and confirmation restore is available without enterprise licensing.
